description: The app's own store listing signals for one country (name and subtitle are not included): version, in-app events, editorial placements, similar-apps shelves and the screenshot set (iOS), plus the Google Play page (exact install count, rating histogram, ad/IAP flags, chart badge). `ios.listingExtras` holds the languages the app supports, its star breakdown (1★ to 5★), live and upcoming in-app events, the promotional text and the featured in-app purchases; on Free it carries the language count, the first 5 languages and the star breakdown, and `locked` shows how many of the rest there are. `timeline` lists the dated changes we detected on the listing — the cheapest explanation for a rank move. measured=false means the page was never read; it is not the same as an empty page.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: get_store_page
